You bring strong reporting discipline – collecting, structuring, and communicating activity and results to stakeholders and peers Business curiosity. You want to understand why a role exists, how it fits the business, what problem the hire will solve, and what “great” actually looks like beyond the job description A problem-solving mindset. You do not just flag issues; you come with options. When a search is not working, you are already thinking about what to test next Operational discipline. You can move from a quick Teams nudge to a polished leadership update while keeping the message clear, practical, and client-first Comfort with ambiguity. Executive and specialty roles do not always come with a clear playbook. You are energized, not frustrated, by searches that require you to figure things out as you go Collaborative team mindset.
